tier_decisions.gqa_balanced: No larger tier required for a controlled-mean 95% CI half-width of 0.005.
tier_decisions.clevr: Create a new 128-disjoint-pair audited tier for a 0.010 target; do not overwrite audited_v1. The worst-model normal approximation estimates 106 pairs.
tier_decisions.vizwiz_vqa: Retain the 500-sample descriptive cohort tier; no controlled-pair precision claim.

interpretation_limits: Response classes are sample-conditional descriptive states, not immutable neuron identities.
M does not establish causal cross-modal interaction; W does not mean inactive.
GQA bootstrap units are 100 image-level pair groups, not 1,000 independent edges.
GQA and CLEVR controlled rates are not directly comparable because their pairing interventions differ.
VizWiz cohorts are observational and do not define controlled counterfactual pairs.
The experiment has one seed; cross-seed uncertainty remains unmeasured.
